k3_verdict_check.why: No K3 trigger carried evidential -mIş or -(y)mIş. The 12 -mIştIr / suspended -mIş cases are the encyclopedic certainty perfect, and the 8 -mIştI cases are the evidentially neutral pluperfect. The row's own note says -mIştIr marks no source. So morphologically 20/49 contain -mIş, functionally 0/49 are marked as indirect; 19/49 assert direct with -DI, 10/49 sit where the choice is not forced.
